summary: Regression + new-feature testing for Zoho Sync scaffolding and Cash Sales. All 17 backend pytest tests pass (12 previous + 5 new). Zoho page and cash-sale UI flows verified end-to-end via Playwright: Not Connected state with org 11000077883 & Canada (.ca), Sync Now disabled, instructions panel visible; cash sale created (CASH-1025) with new buyer, $320 no-tax total, CASH source badge shows on Invoices grid, inventory deducted, toast confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_invoices sorts by date only (YYYY-MM-DD string), so same-day invoices appear in insertion (natural) order — the newest CASH sale is NOT guaranteed to be row 0. Consider secondary sort by created_at DESC for reliable UX.

compute_customer_analytics does not tag/split cash vs manual vs zoho revenue — analytics currently treats all sources equally. If the owner needs to see 'cash-only revenue' separately, add a breakdown per source.

POST /api/cash-sales trusts client-provided qty for existing customer without checking product stock_qty > 0 (allows stock to go negative). Same is true for /api/invoices. Consider a validation to prevent negative inventory or at least warn.
zoho_scheduler starts on every worker; in multi-worker setups this can double-sync. Consider a distributed lock or leader-only flag.
Cash customer creation matches by name+is_cash=True — two walk-ins with identical names collapse into one customer record. Acceptable trade-off, but worth noting.

seed_data_creation: Two new cash sales created during tests: CASH-1025 (TEST_Walkin_UI_...) via UI flow + CASH-* records for pytest cases. Also 1 backend invoice test. Pre-existing CASH-1021 (Walk-in Joe) from manual curl remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zoho creds still absent by design — do NOT flag Not Connected / 400 on /api/zoho/sync as a bug. When creds land, re-verify /zoho/status returns configured:true and Sync Now succeeds (baseline import path in zoho_sync.py). Cash sales end-to-end (backend + UI) fully validated. Invoices list sort ordering by date-only means newest same-day rows are not necessarily on top; use invoice_number match instead of row index for assertions.
